name: arcmoq
description: ArcMOQ — UAE SME group purchasing with AI procurement and Arc testnet settlement

scripts.vercel-build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend && npm run copy:public
scripts.copy:public: rm -rf public && mkdir -p public && cp -r frontend/dist/* public/
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.start: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w frontend && npm run serve -w backend
scripts.serve: npm run vercel-build && npm run serve -w backend
